# Interface constructor arguments

This independently authored interface initializes four fields with mixed
primitive constructor arguments. An additional constructor has a different
arity. Class initialization and constructors call an opaque observer before
the instance final fields are assigned, exposing initialization order and
partial object state. Floating inputs retain their raw sign and NaN bits.

The frozen observer checks original object identities, completed fields,
receiver escape, callback changes, exact RuntimeException/Error objects,
initialization failure and reuse of both the class and interface. Source and
dependency profiles compile all emitted Java8 units and preserve all original
definitions, roles, metadata and Exceptions. Independent wrong programs run
before recovery; metadata controls preserve all original Code attributes.
